# Frame OS

**A software ecosystem by AGP.**

Frame OS is an ongoing software development project focused on building a connected ecosystem of operating systems and software experiences.

## Products
- Frame OS TV

## Development
Frame OS is currently in the planning and development stage. Development priorities and technical specifications will be published as the project progresses.

## Creator
AGP

## Status
Early development and planning.
